brief:
今日经济主线是油价走弱缓解加息焦虑、欧元承压与大额并购三件事。美国偏软的就业数据降低了美联储继续加息的压力，亚洲股市与新兴市场资产同步走高，铜价连涨两日。供给端沙特将销往亚洲的旗舰油价砍至六年最低，叠加G7同意释放柴油和原油储备、霍尔木兹海峡通行恢复又再生变，油价承压下行。欧元则跌至17个月低点，西班牙提前大选传闻与法国财政困境打击信心。一句话点评：宽松预期回温让风险资产喘口气，但油市份额战与欧洲政治风险仍是悬顶之剑。

Top5：
1. 沙特意外将销亚油价砍至六年最低——沙特阿美下调旗舰油价，海湾产油国在霍尔木兹流量回升之际抢份额。原文链接：https://www.bloomberg.com/news/articles/2026-10-05/saudis-cut-flagship-oil-price-to-asia-to-lowest-in-six-years
2. 欧元跌至17个月低点——西班牙提前大选传闻叠加地区财政与政治风险，欧元持续承压。原文链接：https://www.bloomberg.com/news/articles/2026-10-05/euro-falls-to-17-month-low-on-region-s-fiscal-political-risks
3. 法国施耐德电气接近以约200亿美元收购美国软件商PTC——若达成将是工业软件重磅交易，付费墙仅用标题摘要。原文链接：https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMivwFBVV95cUxPbDYwbWo2TEdHQ1hRMWtvbWpHMGkwV1BfRmRNTUlfM0NfTFFQUzNyYXRJTEVGbHFLV28wZFl2WDF3d1JCZENIbExEZVE0SDJnelhla1V2azdUcFZSRUIyLVByMjBFRTQ4TGluUGE1N2g2MVRNeEhfX2diQ3JXTGcxOU5qM252VE5RWENadzR0SXl0bDFaUWlHbmZoOWVWXzNTOEY3cXFVQmxkMWtrU05ueHRWMG9pYlVZdG1XajZUcw?oc=5

items.title: Euro Falls to 17-Month Low on Region’s Fiscal, Political Risks
items.summary: The euro fell to its weakest level since May 2025 as reports that Spanish government officials are preparing for an early election added to investor concerns over political and fiscal risks across the region.

items.title: Asian Shares Rise as Fed Bets Ease, Euro Drops: Markets Wrap
items.summary: Asian stocks rose along with Treasuries as oil prices declined and softer US jobs data reduced pressure on the Federal Reserve to keep raising interest rates. The euro extended its drop against the dollar.

items.title: India Rate Hike Looms as RBI Grapples With Excess Liquidity
items.summary: The RBI has been withdrawing surplus cash from the banking system as inflation pressures mount.

items.title: Saudis Slash Oil Prices to Asia in Battle for Market Share
items.summary: Saudi Aramco has cut prices for its benchmark oil grade to Asia to a six-year low as Persian Gulf producers race for market share with flows through the Strait of Hormuz increasing.

items.title: Copper Gains as US Jobs Data Offers Relief on Fed Tightening
items.summary: Copper rose for a second session after a US employment report eased pressure on the Federal Reserve to raise interest rates.

items.title: De olho nas eleições
items.summary: Flávio sai à frente de Lula para o segundo turno das eleições. Com Patricia Xavier. Produção de Daniel Carvalho, Catarina Bacci, Fabiola Moura e Mariana Lumy. (Source: Bloomberg)

items.title: Emerging-Market Assets Climb as Fed Hike Bets Cool, Oil Drops
items.summary: Emerging-market stocks and currencies advanced after softer-than-expected US jobs data and a further decline in oil prices helped ease concern over aggressive interest-rate hikes by the Federal Reserve.

items.title: Homin Lee: Equity Markets Can Manage Yield Rise
items.summary: Homin Lee, senior macro strategist at Lombard Odier, says equity valuations can handle the ongoing rise in global yields. He argues higher yields reflect solid economic fundamentals rather than aggressive monetary tightening. (Source: Bloomberg)

items.title: Firmus Said to Plan Allocating Half of IPO to Existing Investors
items.summary: Firmus Grid Ltd. plans to allocate about half of the shares in its initial public offering to existing shareholders, putting Nvidia Corp and Blackstone Group in a position to increase their stakes, according to people familiar with the matter.

items.title: Thai Bourse Plans Dual-Class Share Structure to Boost Listings
items.summary: Thailand plans to establish a dual-class share structure to entice more companies to list on the local exchange, a move designed to ease the concern of founders about diluting their control and end a lean patch in new listings.

items.title: Flávio Bolsonaro Surges Past Lula, Setting Up a Bitter Brazil Election Runoff
items.summary: Son of imprisoned former president finishes first, leaving the leftist incumbent with an uphill fight ahead of an Oct. 25 runoff.

items.title: Multiple Security Failures Allowed FlyDubai Pilot Into Cockpit
items.summary: Authorities in three countries missed opportunities across the board; “there wasn’t proper vetting.”

items.title: All B-1 Bombers Returning to U.S. From U.K. Base
items.summary: The withdrawal came amid security concerns around the base where several suspects were arrested last week in connection with a suspected plot.

items.title: Oil Was Pouring Out of Hormuz Again. Then Attacks on Ships Resurged.
items.summary: Iran’s targeting of ships has improved, according to a U.S. official, making transits through the Strait of Hormuz riskier.

items.title: FlyDubai Attack Adds New Risks to Dubai’s War-Battered Economy
items.summary: The attack was another blow to the emirate’s image as a haven insulated from the region’s turmoil, after the Iran war raised fears about flying to a city synonymous with luxury travel.
